What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/b6394c3b265b4c49fc6e7d1284ed63c176216f755824578e6bf2d9ef4de8b2bb.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(2,-4).$
